summary.intent: Run a GSD milestone audit for v1.1 of cipher-box to verify definition of done across 26 phases, then close the only orphaned-requirements gap by running Nyquist validation for Phase 18.
summary.outcome: Milestone audit completed (62/66 requirements satisfied; 4 gaps were verification-process gaps, not code gaps). Phase 18 Nyquist validation completed — 25 new interceptor tests written and confirmed green, PERF-01..04 closed — but the two resulting commits are blocked pending 1Password SSH signing approval.

repo: Windows FUSE code lives in crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/ (moved there by phases 25/33); Phase 23's VERIFICATION.md predated that move and appeared to have gaps that no longer exist.
Project enforces a no-direct-commits-to-main rule; all work must go on a feature branch.
All commits require 1Password SSH signing (op-ssh-sign), which blocks in CI/background processes without a user Touch ID approval.
Kubo scrape block is at alloy-config.river:83.
The monorepo uses turbo with default parallelism; vitest adds per-core worker pools on top, creating a multiplicative process storm when test suites run concurrently.
Phases 31 and 32 lack VERIFICATION.md; Phase 32 additionally lacks VALIDATION.md.

code.finding: New file created by Nyquist auditor subagent — 25 tests covering success/error paths, duration math, method/status label dimensions, and /metrics self-exclusion. Had an unused HttpException import that blocked eslint pre-commit hook and had to be removed.
Kubo scrape block — confirmed wired, satisfies PERF-03 manual verification item.

workflow: GSD integration-checker subagents given Bash access will run full build + test suites unless the prompt explicitly restricts them to static analysis; add 'static analysis only — no builds or test suites' to all future checker/verifier subagent prompts.
The 3-source cross-reference (VERIFICATION.md + SUMMARY.md frontmatter + REQUIREMENTS.md traceability) caught stale checkboxes (IPNS-02/03, SDK-08/09) that human reviewers had missed.
Background git commits hang silently when SSH signing is pending; need to watch for op-ssh-sign in the process tree rather than assuming the commit succeeded.

friction: gsd-integration-checker subagent ran the full monorepo test suite (turbo × vitest worker pools) and starved the machine of RAM, crashing the session mid-audit.
Pre-commit eslint hook rejected the new spec file due to an unused HttpException import, requiring a read-edit-recommit cycle.
Background commit process hung for ~5+ minutes waiting on 1Password SSH signing approval with no visible prompt or timeout.
The background task was ultimately killed, leaving commits unconfirmed on branch chore/phase-18-nyquist-validation.
open_items: Approve 1Password SSH signing for the two commits on branch chore/phase-18-nyquist-validation (test(phase-18) and docs(phase-18)) — or rerun commits once signing is ready.
REQUIREMENTS.md edits (IPNS-02/03, SDK-08/09 checkbox flips) are uncommitted.
Re-run /gsd-audit-milestone after Phase 18 commits land to flip audit status from gaps_found to passed.
/gsd-validate-phase 32 — only phase with neither VERIFICATION nor VALIDATION.
Phase 35 live CVM health check + staging secrets confirmation (human action required before /gsd-complete-milestone v1.1).
